quest.title: Pizza From Another Land
quest.description: Kiminami Anna from the Kiminami Restaurant seems to be bothered by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: *sigh* What am I to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler? Great, you have perfect timing!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Do you remember the recipe you wrote for me the last time, when you and Ms. Kamisato came to my store?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Oh, that pizza was so popular that many customers came to the store to order it specially.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: But... some customers also said that they were bored of eating this pizza all the time and asked if I have other pizza flavors.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Although I have tried several methods to make new types of pizza based on feedback from customers...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: But I always feel... that something is lacking, and the response from customers is not very good.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I'm really not good at making pizza...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, you know a lot about this dish, right? Can you give me some advice?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Great! By the way, I've also collected feedback from customers. Give me a moment, I'll look for it.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Miss Matsumoto said that although the pizza in my shop incorporates a lot of ingredients from Inazuma, she heard that Mondstadt pizza is not made like this.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: She said that for such outland delicacies, it's better to retain it's authentic flavor...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: *sigh* But how am I going to know how to make Mondstadt's pizza? Traveler, please help me ask her.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Do you want to take a look at the customer feedback?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Give me a moment, I'll look for it.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: *sigh* Is there anything in the world that will satisfy my taste buds?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kiminami Restaurant's pizza...

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Oh, the pizza you mentioned tastes really good, and it also has a lot of local ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: However, I have tried the authentic Mushroom Pizza before.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: I remember that the pizza was made of Cheese, Cabbage, and Mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I just feel that for such outland delicacies, it's better to retain it's authentic flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, you've returned.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: How did it go, any feedback?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the customers' feedback...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: The original Mushroom Pizza... Hmm, it's worth a try.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: The ingredients to prepare are Cheese, Cabbage, and Mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: We have the other ingredients, but we usually don't stock up on Cheese...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Traveler, could I trouble you to get a block of Cheese?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: I'm counting on you, then. Just a block of Cheese will do.

choices.text: You don't really use Cheese in the store?

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: It's not that we don't use it at all, we just use it very rarely.

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: After all, there are not many dishes in the store that require Cheese, so we don't really stock much of it...

response.speaker: Kiminami Anna
response.text: Anyway, I'm counting on you, Traveler. Please help to bring me a block of Cheese.

talks.objective: Bring the Cheese back to Kiminami Anna

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Have you brought the ingredients back with you?

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Thank you, these ingredients will do.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: The original Mushroom Pizza from Mondstadt, I don't know if I can make it successfully...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: It's done!

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: This pizza looks... pretty good...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, these are for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: I'll make sure to savor this pizza's taste...

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: If it's not bad...it should be officially launched as a new dish soon.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Anna
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe I'm really not good at making pizza...

dialogues.speaker: Matsumoto
dialogues.text: The Mushroom Pizza tastes really good, you must try it if you have the chance.
